themes.title: Right-wing parties push anti-immigration policies in Europe
themes.blurb: Across Europe, right-wing and far-right parties are intensifying their focus on anti-immigration policies, with parallel legislative efforts and rhetorical framing appearing in multiple countries. This theme reflects a shared transnational priority to restrict immigration and enforce stricter border controls, often framed as a national security or cultural preservation issue.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP proposes that immigrants cover interpreter costs, criticizing high spending on translation services.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK's mayoral candidate vows to combat illegal migration and prioritize stricter immigration controls.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD's 100-day program in Saxony-Anhalt includes immediate deportations and stricter asylum policies.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Salvini emphasizes illegal immigration as Europe's main threat, dismissing Russia as a concern.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN proposes halving France's EU budget contribution and tightening immigration policies.

themes.title: Iran threatens Western leaders amid escalating tensions
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right media across multiple countries are amplifying threats from Iran against Western leaders, particularly in response to U.S. military actions and diplomatic stances. This theme reflects a shared transnational concern over Iran's aggressive posturing and its implications for regional stability and national security.

themes.title: Javier Milei’s economic reforms spark global right-wing emulation
themes.blurb: Argentina's President Javier Milei is pushing radical economic reforms, including central bank restructuring and deregulation, which are being closely watched and emulated by right-wing movements globally. This theme reflects a transnational interest in Milei’s libertarian policies as a model for economic overhaul.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei proposes sweeping reforms to Argentina's Central Bank, aiming to limit its role and ban monetary financing of deficits.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration's deregulatory efforts, including environmental and financial reforms, mirror Milei's policies.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox advocates for deregulation and economic reforms inspired by Milei’s libertarian approach.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK’s economic policies, including tax cuts and deregulation, align with Milei’s libertarian agenda.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian right-wing parties discuss economic reforms that echo Milei’s focus on deregulation and fiscal responsibility.

themes.title: Right-wing parties clash over electoral reforms
themes.blurb: Electoral reforms are a contentious issue among right-wing parties in Europe, with debates over preference voting, term limits, and constitutional changes creating divisions. This theme highlights the parallel struggles within right-wing coalitions to shape electoral systems to their advantage.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungary's parliament debates constitutional amendments to remove the president and impose term limits, sparking political turmoil.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox opposes electoral reforms proposed by Spain’s government, advocating for stricter immigration-linked voting policies.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
